summary: A community giveaway shared on X, not verified by freetokens. The post by @ben_ai_eng (display name Ben Newell), dated 2026-11-17, says: “I have 10 codes to give away, each covering one month of Devin Max ($200 value each).” On how winners are chosen, the post says: “I’ll pick 10 builders based on a clear goal and how they’d use the month.” Its terms, quoted: “These codes are for the Devin Max subscription.” “One month per person. Payment card required to redeem.” “Entries close Friday November 20.” The post gives no time zone.
